claims.statement: For every actual eligible lower-half rank of every ordinary path-star with m>=1 and r_i in {2,3,4}, each represented branch satisfies 2*T_i[j]>=3*delta*D_j.
claims.scope: Original universal scope uses the actual least strict zero-extended parent descent x, x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, 2p<=alpha, j=p-2, delta=q-j, D_j=binom(N,j+1)-binom(N,j), and original ordinary path-star factors. This review proves only the m>=120 restriction, in fact strictly, with no selector premise. The m<120 portion remains open here.
claims.reason: An independent analytic proof establishes the full stated rank band for m>=120. The exact small range is outside this proof and no census certificate for it was independently reviewed.

claims.statement: For every ordinary path-star with m>=120 and every actual eligible lower-half p, using the exact current-p strict selectors e0=1[Delta_p A0<0] and ei=1[Delta_p Ai<0], original endpoint multiplicity one and branch-tip multiplicity r_i, selected MASS A>=b*delta*D_j holds whenever at least one branch is selected or no tag is selected.
claims.scope: Actual first strict zero-extended parent descent including terminal difference; all three rank guards; j=p-2; branch flags and endpoint flag evaluated at current p; b=e0+sum_i r_i ei and A=sum_i r_i ei T_i[j]. It excludes endpoint-only selection and makes no claim for m<120.
claims.reason: The branchwise strict 3/2 bound gives A>(3/2)w*delta*D_j for selected tip weight w>=2, which pays (w+e0)*delta*D_j for e0 in {0,1}. The empty selection is trivial. No endpoint-only selector exclusion is supplied.

claims.statement: For every ordinary path-star in the contract, at every actual eligible lower-half p, the exact selected ratio inequality (delta*C[j]-(delta-1)*C[j+1])*A >= b*delta*D_j*C[j] holds.
claims.scope: All m>=1, actual least strict zero-extended first descent including terminal difference, all three rank guards, current-p strict selectors, original endpoint multiplicity one and branch-tip multiplicities r_i. This review proves payment only on the m>=120 non-endpoint-only selector subcase; the registered all-profile predicate is not resolved.
claims.reason: The m>=120 conditional MASS implication is insufficient when only the endpoint is selected and does not cover m<120. No full primary proof or counterexample is provided.

limitations: No proof of the local branch bound for m<120 was produced.
No census-free endpoint-only exclusion was proved, so the all-profile primary exact-ratio predicate remains open.
Exact finite checks in audit_m120.json are supporting spot checks, not universal proof evidence.
The branchwise proof depends on the separately accepted/formally verified coefficient-only rank bound 2N<=5k at every strict descent; it does not formalize the graph-to-polynomial bridge.
No Lean award or authoritative registry status is claimed.
